title: cvpw cues/lyrics.json
description: Lyric TEXT. Optional, and git-ignored by default: the text belongs to its owner, not to this project. Timing lives separately in lyrics.timing.json so a project can be delivered without the words (docs/SPEC.md T7).

source.description: Where the text came from. 'official' means supplied by the rights holder; anything else needs the licence field on project.json.

i.description: Must match the index in lyrics.timing.json; a mismatch is a contract violation.

emphasis.description: A キメ / hook line the picture should treat as a signature moment.

markup.description: Optional display markup for the text layer. Kept out of `text` so the words themselves stay exactly as the rights holder wrote them.
